About us

20 years of pioneering excellence

Aditya Enterprises caters to the needs of customers worldwide with a wide range of products. Foreseeing the vital role that Aluminium would play in the future, we invested in technology and quality assurance, working towards a position of undisputed leadership in anodizing. Our products are used in diverse segments ranging from constructions to consumer durables, transport to textiles, and irrigation to electrification.

Every great accomplishment begins with a dream & every dream needs people who can make it come true. Aditya Enterprises is a cutting-edge organization with a combination of highly talented people, pioneering in anodizing and chromating, backed up by advanced technologies and a dedicated customer-focused culture. ‘So everything you need is here, look no further’.

Services

Full-stack aluminium finishing

Five specialist processes under one roof — engineered for repeatable colour, hardness and dimensional tolerance.

Aluminium Anodising Coating

Type II sulfuric anodizing — decorative and corrosion protection from 8–25 microns.

Bright Dip Anodizing

Chemical polishing followed by anodizing for a mirror-bright, chrome-like finish.

Aluminium Hard Anodising

Type III thick-film coating up to 60 microns for wear-critical, high-load parts.

Aluminium Chromating

Alodine / conversion coating for paint adhesion and light corrosion resistance.

Glass Bead Blasting

Uniform matte pre-treatment for consistent anodizing appearance and grip.

Industry Applications

Finishes trusted across six sectors

Automotive

Engine components, decorative trim, suspension parts.

Electrical

Heat sinks, bus bars, switchgear enclosures.

Solar

Mounting frames, inverter housings, panel rails.

Aerospace

Structural fittings, landing gear components, hydraulic valves.

Consumer Electronics

Laptop enclosures, smartphone frames, audio equipment.

Architecture

Facade panels, window frames, curtain wall systems.
